source_snapshot.items: Test connections between BMC I2C-6 and I2C switches on both carrier boards
source_snapshot.procedure: On BMC run broad `i2cdetect -y -q 5` and forced `i2cget -f -y 5 0x73`; PID1114953.
source_snapshot.criteria: Collect evidence/photos and check logs; no per-board selector or expected byte.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO; replaces a remote switch read with probing/soldering.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Recognizes one response cannot prove two boards and flags `-f`, but still makes physical inspection primary and lacks per-instance downstream proof.

old_problem: One ambiguous bus5/0x73 read is offered for two carrier-board switches; per-board selection, switch identity/control byte, downstream endpoint matrix, owner policy, route preservation and recovery are undefined.
disposition_reason: The plural board coverage is remotely testable but cannot be inferred from one shared address response. ED-19 preserves each board's identity and ED-03 requires authoritative selector/topology and response semantics; broad scan and forced access are not accepted by default.
decision_basis: Read XLSX row137, same-row AI fields and history2526; row138 baseline was directly read and excluded from the pending queue.
Preserved BMC I2C-6,bus5,0x73 and both carrier-board switch identities.
Required independent selection/control/downstream evidence for board A and board B.
No blind scan, route write, forced owner bypass, probe, retry or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: BMC I2C-6 switch connectivity on both carrier boards
test_case.purpose: Prove BMC I2C-6 reaches each carrier-board switch and its approved downstream endpoints while preserving switch routing.
required_package: PID1114953 bus5 topology and selector path for each board's0x73
Switch part/revision and expected control-byte mask per instance
Non-mutating downstream endpoint/reply matrix for each board
Driver/daemon ownership and exceptional `-f` approval if needed
Timeout/NACK criteria, route-state verification/restoration and BMC recovery
test_case.test_command: Do not scan broadly. After topology/ownership approval, record original routing; select board A through the authoritative path and read its0x73 control state plus approved downstream endpoints, then repeat independently for board B; avoid `-f` unless approved, never change channels, and verify routing/health afterward.
test_case.expected_result: Each identified switch returns its expected control state and its own downstream endpoint matrix matches PID; original routing remains unchanged and both boards/BMC show no new error.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires distinct board-A and board-B identities and evidence. One ACK/control byte, guessed selector, missing downstream branch, changed route, NACK/timeout/stuck bus or new management error fails.
safety_gate: Do not broad-scan or force a bound switch without owner approval.
Read only; capture and preserve routing/channel state.
Stop on ambiguity or first error without retry/reset/route write.
expected_evidence: Board and switch identities plus ownership baseline
Per-board downstream endpoint matrix with timestamps/status
Unchanged routing, sibling reachability, pre/post errors and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: No route change is authorized. If state differs, preserve evidence and use only the approved switch/selector restoration; do not guess a channel mask or retry automatically.

source_conflict.reason: Plural two-board scope has only one ambiguous address read and no selector/value/downstream oracle; prior reviews add unsourced probing.

blocked.reason: Per-board functional testing is clear; topology, oracles and ownership are obtainable RPUC inputs.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Per-board0x73 selection/identity, control and downstream oracles, owner-safe access, route preservation and recovery.
pending.execution_status: ENGINEERING DECISION RETAINED; REQUIRES CONFIRMATION; NO DUT ACTION EXECUTED
pending.unlock_condition: Approve both board paths and read-only evidence matrices plus recovery, then revise the record.

project_authority: PID1114953 and the installed I2C-switch datasheet/driver ownership define selection and expected state.
